Reply to owner’s reply below

As for my reviews, I will continue to share my experience because I don’t want others to waste their hard-earned money on a defective product that brings nothing but financial, physical, and mental stress !!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Jignesh,
We are genuinely surprised and disappointed to read your review. Since the day you purchased your chandelier from us, we have been consistently in touch and have assisted you multiple times—even though the product does not carry a warranty.
•When the LED fused the first time, we promptly replaced it.
•When the same issue happened again, we provided you with another LED completely free of charge.
•Now, after 4 months of use, the LED has fused once more. As we explained, this issue is likely due to a wiring problem at your home, not the chandelier itself.
Despite this, we still offered you a solution: bring the chandelier back to us and we will repair it for you at a minimal cost. Instead of proceeding with the solution, you have unfortunately chosen to post multiple negative reviews from different accounts, calling us fraudulent. These allegations are unfair and untrue.
We remain committed to resolving your issue if you bring the chandelier back to our store for repair. For further assistance, please feel free to contact us directly at +91 89-28-89-28-89.
We always strive to support our customers and will continue to do so.
